scope: Full reviewed corrected principal contract, with each of 81 N005 source records explicitly disposed. Not every literal assertion is affirmed. Earlier candidate labels are superseded by integrated/root/citation reviews and this admission, without changing frozen evidence.
retained_limits: Seven classical N005 interfaces retain their original attribution and unpriced complete proofs.
General fundamental geometry, choice independence and categorical universal questions are not settled here.
The unrestricted nonfirm HNN statement has a separate counterexample. Positive HNN and amalgamation theorems retain their exact hypotheses.
Unused stronger RC1-only and FIRM-only auxiliary formulations remain outside this declared principal contract.
General Shephard intersection properties and representation faithfulness are not inferred from the full-space generator separation argument.
The nine-case companion must be read with the HN companion; later Fischer exception answers remain a separate edition.
The 17 Lean components do not prove every source statement, geometric hypothesis, finite witness or GAP algorithm.
The complete source historical software, retained outside proofs, graphic structures and full formalization costs remain unknown.
